name: giftflow/thank-donor
title: Thank Donor
description: Displays a thank-you message after a donor completes a donation, with configurable heading, message, and CTA button.

message.default: Your donation has been received and will make a real difference. You'll receive a confirmation email shortly.

accountNotice.default: We've created an account for you. Check your email for login details to track your donations and manage your account.
